publication_status_authority: The source-bound release evidence sidecar and published v0.10.0 tag; this source ledger precedes its future CI/publication result.
status_meaning: repair_implemented identifies code and regression coverage, not a claim that final CI/publication has already occurred. Final source-bound observations belong to release assets.
review_method: Scoped read-only fresh-context reviews, reproduced negative controls, isolated repairs, parent re-verification and integration checks. Reviewers used the configured model; this is not cross-model or independently graded effectiveness research.

findings.defect: Forced slice removal discarded owner work.
findings.repair: Non-forced removal, ownership and branch checks; dirty/untracked/ignored/locked work retains its registry.

findings.defect: Migration deleted conflicting or uncopied legacy memory.
findings.repair: Preflight conflicts and IDs; delete only proven complete identical source copies.

findings.defect: Memory lane traversal could read/delete outside-owned JSONL.
findings.repair: Central identifiers, owned path checks and link refusal for every lane operation.

findings.defect: Lock reclamation could steal a live/replacement lock and lose writes.
findings.repair: Owned tokens, serialized reclaimer, proven-dead PID recovery and exit cleanup; malformed ownership fails closed.

findings.defect: Concurrent memory rewrites and ID allocation lost records.
findings.repair: Serialized store transaction, atomic text publication, journaled recoverable multi-file updates.

findings.defect: Uninstall could destroy unmigrated memory or race a new slice.
findings.repair: Shared lifecycle lease, readable-state preflight, legacy/pending-journal refusals and coordinated control-plane writers.

findings.defect: Failed worktree removal was reported successful and forgotten.
findings.repair: Retain registration on failure; release a stale lane only after both owned path and Git registry prove absence.

findings.defect: Resume ignored additions/configuration and could reconstruct a mixed state snapshot.
findings.repair: Complete path-set comparison, config hashing, lifecycle-consistent position/hash capture and unique monotonic checkpoints.

findings.defect: Integrity walks followed external/cyclic links.
findings.repair: Owned-path checks reject linked integrity inputs and special traversal.

findings.defect: Refused commands leaked locks; rejected memory additions already changed records.
findings.repair: Read-only next, owned exit cleanup and validate/stage all memory references before publication.

findings.defect: Predictable temporary files allowed link-directed JSON/journal overwrites.
findings.repair: Random exclusive-create temporary publication; journal uses its owned atomic writer.

findings.defect: Alternate refs and Windows case aliases bypassed receipts/quarantine and split counters.
findings.repair: Exact local-ref spelling, canonical accounting and rejection of unsupported revision expressions.

findings.defect: Double prefix stripping made clean verify a different nested branch.
findings.repair: Unambiguous fully qualified child ref and explicit quarantine identity.

findings.defect: Malformed stored quality receipts could earn strict PASS.
findings.repair: Consumer-side schema, criterion/result correspondence, numeric exit/hash checks and committed-plan matching.

findings.defect: Evidence validated one commit while a mutable ref/checkout could run different code.
findings.repair: Frozen base/feature SHAs, before/after checkout identity and moved-ref refusal; snapshot receipts for execution.

findings.defect: Concurrent replacement could upgrade an invocation's failure or overwrite another RED acquisition; unrelated stale receipts also blocked orderly refresh.
findings.repair: Validate own observed outcome/full RED identity; capture refresh is independent while combined merge/status still enforce all current receipts.

findings.defect: Concurrent exports replaced an observation despite existence prechecks.
findings.repair: Complete-file, atomic create-only publication with an exclusive destination.

findings.defect: Runner deadlines were not preserved for integrated tests; strict flag typos were ignored.
findings.repair: Recorded explicit runner deadline, bounded oracle budget and unknown-flag refusal. The default runner remains 60 seconds.

findings.defect: Out-of-domain provider values became confident judgments.
findings.repair: Validate noul/confidence ranges, choices, integral score levels and probability entries; visible unavailable escalation on malformed answers.

findings.defect: Ambiguous request IDs/types and oversized question text evaded input bounds; unavailable scores became theater.
findings.repair: Strict request shape/uniqueness, complete payload ceiling and UNMEASURED cycle summaries.

findings.defect: Wrapper history and optional skill-judge content repeated credential-shaped text.
findings.repair: Shared pattern redaction at model egress and wrapper-owned output/history; arbitrary-secret detection remains outside the claim.

findings.defect: Operational npm errors, invalid budgets, missing Windows compiler-shim detection and empty monitoring could express false success.
findings.repair: Validate audit metadata, thresholds and local compiler paths; empty/unavailable results stay UNMEASURED and malformed declarations refuse.

findings.defect: Streaming responses bypassed inactivity timers and unbounded JSON buffering.
findings.repair: Total per-attempt deadline and response byte cap with socket teardown.

findings.defect: Exec applied POSIX shell quoting on Windows and did not promptly stop owned descendants.
findings.repair: Literal argv vs explicit shell-string separation, strict options and owned process-group/tree cancellation.

findings.defect: Configured lane limits were not the real throttle; unknown app scopes and Windows absolute contract paths were accepted.
findings.repair: Update the actual global cap, validate limits/paths and refuse unknown app scopes. Acceptance remains explicitly branch-scoped.

findings.defect: Fast-lane validation held a state lease across child Aegis commands.
findings.repair: Release for tests, reacquire and verify the same active fix before closing.

findings.defect: Init overwrote owner brain files and could reset active/legacy data before validating app input.
findings.repair: Preserve owner seeds/templates, preflight app names and refuse active/unmigrated resets.

findings.defect: Static re-export cycles and sources with node_modules as a partial folder name were missing from the TypeScript graph.
findings.repair: Include module-bearing export edges and exclude only actual dependency path segments; dynamic/polyglot graphs remain explicitly outside this check.

findings.defect: Release checks could use stale dist and local-only checks announced tag clearance.
findings.repair: Fresh build before compiled checks, no failed-build fallback, explicit non-release local result and effective Git hook lookup.

findings.defect: A pinned source URL did not pin the installed runtime; initial package attempt omitted its consumer lock.
findings.repair: Explicit consumer-lock allowlist, bundled locked runtime, isolated script-free offline install and SHA256 sidecar.

findings.defect: Tool declarations were reported as availability; hooks ignored effective paths or broke on spaces.
findings.repair: Discover installed tools, native PATH probes, quoted CLI fallback and owned effective hook paths.

findings.defect: Self-update selected source archives and enabled installation scripts instead of the verified built asset.
findings.repair: Canonical GitHub asset URL, argv installation, scripts disabled and bounded network/install commands.

findings.defect: An old ship approval could authorize a later source commit.
findings.repair: G4 binds the approved source SHA and refuses stale approval or open lanes; no autonomy-full ship exception.

findings.defect: Specification, setup and site mixed deferred routing, stale metrics and universal enforcement/effectiveness claims.
findings.repair: Qualified trust boundaries and historical observations; explicit v0.11 slice contracts and unmeasured trial/study work; actual discovery/craft record.

findings.defect: Real-browser checks found low-contrast muted text, a color-only footer link, 320px horizontal overflow and a non-keyboard-focusable scrolling transcript.
findings.repair: Accessible muted token, footer-link underline, wrapping navigation/stacked CTAs and a labelled focusable transcript; browser checks plus manual SVG contrast assessment.

findings.defect: The 10s lock acquisition bound wedged the audit's own 20-way contention check on slow Windows CI hardware (19/20 events recorded).
findings.repair: Raise the anti-wedge bound to 60s with unchanged exclusive creation, ownership and reclamation; refusal still names the bound and never grants ownership.

limits_for_visible_owner_verdict: No cryptographic human-proof or OS sandbox against unrestricted local shell actors.
Skill/source verification and review receipts do not prove procedure quality, customer truth or semantic adequacy.
Legacy missing receipts still need explicit strict flags; strict-profile migration is planned v0.11 work.
Structural doc-contract heuristics, dynamic/polyglot graphs, power-loss durability, arbitrary external writers and independent effectiveness/cost are not claimed as fully verified.
A scripted smoke and development calibration bank do not constitute a genuine small-model delivery trial or held-out benchmark.
